migrations.reason: Initial V2 application schema on a new database; creates additive schema, enums, tables, constraints, and indexes only.
migrations.recovery: On a disposable target, recreate the database. On a durable target, retain the additive schema and use a reviewed forward-fix migration.

migrations.reason: Adds translation, ingestion, and explicitly approved alias structures without changing existing rows.
migrations.recovery: Retain the additive structures for blue-green compatibility and use a reviewed forward-fix migration if needed.

migrations.reason: Adds backward-compatible claim, lease, retry scheduling, and attempt-limit columns to PostgreSQL application jobs; replaces only the supporting claim index with a superset key.
migrations.recovery: Retain the nullable/defaulted columns and superset index for blue-green compatibility; use a reviewed forward-fix migration if claim policy needs adjustment.

migrations.reason: Adds backward-compatible document-to-segment mapping plus nullable source binding and zero-default materialization metrics; existing translations remain readable by older application code and are only trusted by Phase 8 after explicit content-sync backfill.
migrations.recovery: Retain the additive table and columns for blue-green compatibility. If reconciliation policy needs correction, deploy a reviewed forward fix and replay an explicit idempotent content sync from the canonical GitHub commit.

migrations.reason: Adds a backward-compatible execution mode, force/cancellation control, request counts and segment progress metrics to the existing translation-job table; all columns have safe defaults for Phase 8 application overlap.
migrations.recovery: Retain the additive enum and columns for blue-green compatibility. Disable explicit translation execution, preserve completed segment rows, and deploy a reviewed forward fix before resuming jobs.

migrations.reason: Adds an independently rebuildable locale-aware search projection and PGroonga index without changing canonical documents, translations, routes, or existing application-job rows.
migrations.recovery: Retain the additive projection table for blue-green overlap. Disable search polling or public search on error, deploy a reviewed forward fix, and replay a PostgreSQL-backed search_reindex job from current runtime content.
